# Goblin Raider

- Type: Monster
- Id: goblin-raider
- Source: Barrowdale, original homebrew 0.4.0
- Attribution: Original Outset VTT example content, MIT license.
- Size: Small
- Creature type: Fey
- Alignment: Chaotic Neutral
- Armor Class: 15
- Hit Points: 10 (3d6)
- Speed: 30 feet
- Skills: Stealth +6
- Senses: Darkvision 60 feet, Passive Perception 9
- Languages: Common, Goblin
- Challenge: 1/4 (50 XP)

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 8 | 14 | 10 | 10 | 8 | 8 |

Goblin raiders slip down from the barrow hills at dusk to steal sheep, tools and anything left unguarded in Barrowdale.

## Trait: Nimble Escape

The goblin can take the Disengage or Hide action as a Bonus Action on each of its turns.

## Action: Scimitar

- Attack: Melee, +4 to hit, reach 5 feet, one target
- Hit: 1d6 + 2 slashing damage

## Action: Shortbow

- Attack: Ranged, +4 to hit, range 80/320 feet, one target
- Hit: 1d6 + 2 piercing damage

sourceData.markdown:
# Barrow Wight

- Type: Monster
- Id: barrow-wight
- Source: Barrowdale, original homebrew 0.4.0
- Attribution: Original Outset VTT example content, MIT license.
- Size: Medium
- Creature type: Undead
- Alignment: Neutral Evil
- Armor Class: 16 (chain mail)
- Hit Points: 90 (12d8 + 36)
- Speed: 30 feet
- Saving throws: Constitution +6, Wisdom +4
- Skills: Perception +4
- Senses: Darkvision 60 feet
- Languages: The languages it knew in life
- Challenge: 5 (1,800 XP)
- Legendary actions: 2
- Legendary resistance: 2/Day

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 18 | 14 | 16 | 10 | 12 | 15 |

The chieftain buried beneath the great barrow still wears his rusted mail and guards his grave goods against the living.

## Trait: Sunlight Sensitivity

While in sunlight, the wight has Disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks.

## Action: Multiattack

The wight makes one Barrow Blade attack and one Grave Grasp attack.

## Action: Barrow Blade

- Attack: Melee, +7 to hit, reach 5 feet, one target
- Hit: 1d8 + 4 slashing damage

## Action: Grave Grasp

- Attack: Melee, +7 to hit, reach 5 feet, one target
- Hit: 2d6 + 4 necrotic damage
- On hit: Grappled (escape DC 14)

## Action: Grave Chill

- Uses: Recharge 5-6
- Save: Constitution 14, half damage on a success
- Area: 15-foot cone
- Hit: 6d6 cold damage

## Bonus action: Grave Hunger

- Uses: 1/Day
- Target: Self
- Effect: Regain 20 hit points

## Legendary action: Shadow Step

The wight moves up to its speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

# Hill Folk

- Type: Species
- Id: hill-folk
- Source: Barrowdale, original homebrew 0.4.0
- Attribution: Original Outset VTT example content, MIT license. References the separately attributed SRD Fire Bolt and Light entries.
- Size: Medium
- Speed: 30 feet
- Darkvision: 60 feet

Hill folk herd sheep and dig for iron in the uplands above Barrowdale. Long winters in sod houses have made them hardy, and every family keeps a hearth gift passed from grandparent to grandchild.

## Trait: Hardy

- Hit point maximum: +1 per level

## Choice: Hearth Gift

- Choose: 1
- Spellcasting ability: Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma

### Option: Hearthfire

- Spell: Fire Bolt (level 1)

### Option: Hearthlight

- Spell: Light (level 1)

# Keen Watcher

- Type: Feat
- Id: keen-watcher
- Source: Barrowdale, original homebrew 0.4.0
- Category: General
- Prerequisite: Level 4+
- Ability score increase: +1 Wisdom or Constitution

You have stood the night watch on the dale's walls, and little escapes your notice.

## Passive: Keen Eye

- Effect: +2 to ranged weapon attack rolls
- Effect: Advantage on Perception checks

## Bonus action: Steady Nerves

- Target: Self
- Effect: Gain 5 temporary hit points

## Trait: Night Watch

You need only four hours of sleep to gain the benefit of a Long Rest.
